name: RoboSuite Robotic Manipulation Framework
description: We present a benchmark to facilitate simulated manipulation; an attempt to overcome the obstacles of physical benchmarks through the distribution of a real world, ground truth dataset. Users are given various simulated manipulation tasks with assigned protocols having the objective of replicating the real world results of a recorded dataset. The benchmark comprises of a range of metrics used to characterise the successes of submitted environments whilst providing insight into their deficiencies. We apply our benchmark to two simulation environments, PyBullet and V-Rep, and publish the results. All materials required to benchmark an environment, including protocols and the dataset, can be found at the benchmarks' website https://research.csiro.au/robotics/manipulation-benchmark/.
evaluation_method: Task success rate and/or cumulative reward, depending on the specific manipulation environment and protocol
typical_sota_score: Varies by task and simulator setting; many canonical tasks are achievable by modern RL and imitation-learning methods
notes: Primarily a framework rather than a single fixed leaderboard benchmark; comparisons should specify task, controller interface, and evaluation seed protocol.
